description: Rows m of a Kimi-K3.1 decode or DSpark verify step at TP8 entering the fused all-gather + in_proj GEMM (each rank holds an m x 896 activation slice and 6288 in_proj rows; K = 7168). Rows are the serving configuration's narrow steps (up to 8 rows) and wide verify steps of R requests x 8 tokens (R = 2 .. 48), within the 16-, 32-, 128- and 384-row builds of the baseline (the bench's launch configurations; four compiled widths for the 10-minute budget). Frequencies are AgentX-derived (cc-traces-weka-062126 per-session in-flight distribution at concurrency points C in {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 48}, equal weight per point, renormalized over steps of up to 48 requests); derived from corpus statistics, not yet confirmed by a live capture. Every case reads each rank's 90 MB weight.
